environment: **Two contexts**: (1) personal side projects under `~/dev/` (Next.js web apps, Expo mobile apps; remotes `github.com:simensollie/*`), (2) work product management for Certain QMS / NP365 (docs, PRDs, Linear issues; little or no coding).
**Dotfiles**: `~/dev/dotfiles` is deployed to `~/.config` and `~/.claude` by symlink, so edits there change live system and Claude Code configuration immediately.
**Sensitive data**: never use real customer, member, or employee data in examples, fixtures, or tests (GDPR), synthetic only. `.env*` files hold secrets and are gitignored.
**Protected everywhere**: `main` is the default branch in every repo; production deploys, live payment keys, and writes to hosted (non-local) databases are sensitive regardless of project.
**Per-project infrastructure** (cloud providers, services, protected environments) is declared in each repo's own `.claude/settings.json`, not here.
